# units/week

> n week: weeks: 7 days, as nanoseconds.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/week.pkg)

```
print 1 week   // 604800000000000
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 week` is `2 * (3 week)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```

```

Produces: `int`
